candidates.title: OD-MoE: On-Demand Expert Loading for Cacheless Edge-Distributed MoE Inference
candidates.reason: Cacheless distributed MoE inference using multi-layer-ahead expert prediction and just-in-time loading; ten-node testbed reports 99.94% expert prediction accuracy and about 75% of fully GPU-cached decoding speed with one-third GPU memory. Strong expert offload/prefetch relevance.

candidates.title: TraCT: Disaggregated LLM Serving with CXL Shared Memory KV Cache at Rack-Scale
candidates.reason: Rack-scale disaggregated serving system using CXL shared memory for KV transfer and prefix-aware caching, implemented on NVIDIA Dynamo; reports up to 9.8x average TTFT reduction, 6.2x lower P99 latency, and 1.6x peak throughput over RDMA/DRAM baselines.
